_about: Lane GEAR v79, read by GearTable.cs. slots: 4 armour slots on the shared 106-joint rig + mainHand/offHand + 2 Remnants (Dom 2026-11-05 00:18: the relic slots are called Remnants, not Grafts); the hand and remnant slots are data only (visual false). An item's slot may be a slot id or a group (remnant -> first free of remnant1/remnant2). items: layer = a mesh already on the wearer (Joan base layers), glb/resource = a skinned gear mesh rebound to the wearer's bones by name (part = one node of a multi-mesh glb), coversZones = body zones masked while it is worn, hidesLayers = wearer layer meshes it hides, dropFrom = character ids (roster.json) or *, dropChance 0..1. Starting gear: roster.json rows 'loadout'. boneZones: bone name (lower case, mixamorig: stripped) -> zone, first match wins, prefix/suffix/has all must hold. stats: how armor / poise / weight turn into gameplay (see GearHooks.cs). GEAR2: glbMirror = the other side glb, equipped with glb as ONE pair in the same slot (partMirror = node filter for it); items[].materials and materials.byName = rows {smoothness, metallic, normalScale, sheen} per material NAME applied after the HDRP/Lit swap (-1 / missing = untouched; key * = every material of the item without its own row; precedence item[name] > byName[name] > item[*] > byName[*]); hidesLayers = wearer layer meshes switched off while the item is worn (tabard -> Layer_Tunic); coversZones masks body triangles only when ALL pieces of the item loaded. A missing glb = stats only, one warning.

materials._about: kitGEAR + GEAR2: runtime-loaded glb gear (glTFast) gets HDRP/Lit instead of the glTFast shader-graph materials (GearMaterials.cs). Base colour and normal map are copied; metallic / smoothness / normalScale are these constants (neutral: a material with no row looks like plain dielectric, never chrome), then the rows below and items[].materials are applied. convertGltf false keeps the glTFast materials (rows still apply to clones). styleLayers false leaves the wearer Layer_* meshes untouched. shaderFallbacks: tried when `shader` is not in the build. sheen > 0 uses sheenShader when it exists (hdrp_char_mats.json fabric shader), else stays Lit. byName = materials of the Joan chef glb (Layer_* are flat colour, no textures): Steel = Layer_Helmet / Layer_Greaves, Leather = Layer_Bracers, Heraldry = Layer_Tunic; values are the glb metallic / (1 - roughness) factors.

drop._maxPerKillBy: WEAPONSWAP v88: per-victim cap; a victim without a row uses maxPerKill. Pitborn drops 3: maul + pauldron pair + chest (Dom's loot design).

weaponSwap._about: WEAPONSWAP v88 (WeaponSwap.cs, TwoHandIK.cs). slots = slot ids whose items are weapons (items[].weapon). socket = where the weapon glb is parented (the node WeaponGrip.cs moves); the socket's other children (the default sword LODs) are hidden except keepChildren; trailNode is re-parented under the weapon's tip node. ik: left-arm two-bone solve for twoHanded weapons: palmFrac = palm point on the wrist->middle-finger line, palmToShaftM = palm centre to shaft axis, rollDeg = hand roll about the shaft, flipPalm = turn the hand over if the fist faces away, keepAnimatedRotation = move the wrist only, reachFadeM = IK fades out over this much of out-of-reach distance, poleHintLocal/poleHintMix = elbow side, states/releaseStates = Animator states to limit / release, releaseWhenFrozen = let go during finishers, debugLog = print palm-to-shaft distance every debugEvery frames.
